Forest Border Frame Eco-Friendly – Sustainable 6″x6″ MDF Frame with Preserved Moss Border

Elevate your décor with our Forest Border Frame Eco-Friendly design, created for those who value nature-inspired aesthetics and sustainable craftsmanship. This premium 6″x6″ MDF frame with preserved moss border blends modern minimalism with a lush, forest-themed look, making it a perfect addition to homes, offices, studios, workplaces, and eco-conscious spaces. Crafted with responsibly sourced materials, this décor frame enhances your surroundings while supporting an environmentally friendly lifestyle.

Designed with a dedicated inner photo display area, the frame beautifully highlights your favourite pictures, artworks, inspirational quotes, or brand message. Whether you are decorating your living room, workspace wall, café interior, or gifting clients, the preserved moss texture adds an elegant natural accent that stands out.

The frame comes completely wall mount ready, allowing easy installation without complex hardware. Built for everyday convenience, the preserved moss requires zero maintenance—no watering, trimming, or sunlight exposure needed. This unique composition ensures long-lasting freshness and texture, retaining its natural look and feel for years.

Why Choose?

In a world shifting towards sustainability, décor products made from eco-friendly materials are gaining massive popularity. With high demand for terms such as eco-friendly wall décor, natural designs, and moss art, this option delivers both style and conscious living. The use of MDF makes the sturdy, durable, and lightweight. The preserved moss border adds a refreshing green accent, making it perfect for themed spaces like nature cafés, reception areas, wellness studios, corporate gifting packages, and home décor collections.

Perfect for Gifting and Interior Styling
